caveats: Q2, Q3 and Q4 values are derived by subtracting year-to-date figures, not reported directly as discrete quarters.

Costco's Q1 is a 12-week quarter and Q4 is a 12- or 13-week quarter, while Q2 and Q3 are 12-week quarters, so the quarters are not equal in length. Q1 is 2025-09-01 to 2025-11-23 and Q4 is 2026-05-11 to 2026-08-30. The simple mean treats all four as equal.

claims.text: Q1 fiscal 2026 net cash provided by operating activities was $4.688 billion.
Q2 fiscal 2026 net cash provided by operating activities was $2.996 billion (derived from the first-half total minus Q1).
Q3 fiscal 2026 net cash provided by operating activities was $3.449 billion (derived from the year-to-date total minus the first half).
Q4 fiscal 2026 net cash provided by operating activities was $4.684 billion (derived from the full-year total minus the first three quarters).
The average quarterly net cash provided by operating activities across the four quarters of fiscal 2026 was about $3.954 billion.

raw_output.summary: Costco's average quarterly net cash provided by operating activities over fiscal 2026 was about $3.954 billion. The four quarters were $4.688 billion (Q1), $2.996 billion (Q2), $3.449 billion (Q3) and $4.684 billion (Q4).
